guidelines.trigger: What makes a good frame image?
guidelines.size_value: {{width}} x {{height}} px is ideal. Any image with the same 450:628 card shape works.
guidelines.formats_value: PNG or WebP. Transparency is kept, so cut-out frames work.
guidelines.limits_value: Up to {{maxSizeMb}} MB, and no more than {{maxDimension}} px on either side.
guidelines.cropping_value: Other shapes are centre-cropped to fit the card.
